hero.headline: Complete instructional support for K-12 STEM learning.
hero.subtext: Nova Technology Institute LLC helps school districts, school boards, and K-12 schools achieve strategic education goals and overcome STEM learning challenges through complete instructional support.

about.heading: About Nova Technology Institute
about.body: We empower educators with targeted professional development and teacher training, including specialized programs that enable teachers to leverage AI and serve as educational innovators in their schools. To drive measurable student achievement, we design custom standards-aligned STEM curricula, provide hands-on instructional support, and direct engaging educational competitions.
